Equinix Opens New Data Centre in Berlin

Equinix has opened a new data centre in Berlin, adding capacity for businesses that need local computing infrastructure. The company said the facility would support enterprise customers connecting their systems to cloud providers. Construction began last year and the first customers are expected to move equipment into the building this month.

The project includes additional cooling equipment and a dedicated operations team. According to the announcement, customers will be able to choose from several network connections inside the facility. Equinix did not disclose the total construction cost or identify the first tenants. Further expansion will depend on customer demand and available power.

Local officials welcomed the investment but requested regular updates about energy consumption. The company said it would publish operational information after the facility has completed its first full quarter. This article is an invented test fixture and does not describe an actual company announcement.
